meta.name: Functional Athlete
meta.howToEdit: This file is the whole training plan. The app only displays it. Ask Claude to rewrite a block, session or exercise here; no app code changes needed.
limitations: Lower back: tight, aggravated by bending and sitting. Tight hips.
Block 1 rule: no heavy barbell lifts from the floor and no high-rep barbell work for time.

rules.comment: Used by the rebalancer. legs/upper/intensity are scored 0-3 per session.

bench-press.name: Bench press
bench-press.cue: Feet planted, shoulder blades pinned. Leave 2-4 reps in the tank in Block 1.

weighted-pull-up.name: Weighted pull-up
weighted-pull-up.cue: Log the ADDED weight. Dead hang to chin over bar, no kip.

landmine-press.name: Half-kneeling landmine press
landmine-press.cue: Log plate weight. Squeeze the glute of the down knee, ribs down.

chest-row.name: Chest-supported DB row
chest-row.cue: Log one dumbbell. Chest stays on the pad so the low back does no work.

split-squat.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat
split-squat.cue: Log one dumbbell. Torso tall, front shin near vertical.

sl-rdl.name: Single-leg RDL
sl-rdl.cue: Log one dumbbell. Hinge at the hip with a flat back; stop where the hamstring stops you.

box-jump.name: Box jump
box-jump.cue: Max intent, land soft, STEP down. Full rest between sets.

mb-throw.name: Med ball rotational throw
mb-throw.cue: Side-on to a wall, throw from the hips like a lacrosse shot.

suitcase-carry.name: Suitcase carry
suitcase-carry.cue: One heavy bell at your side. Walk tall, do not lean. This is back armor.

back-squat.name: Back squat (team lift)
back-squat.cue: Log your heaviest set of the day.

hang-clean.name: Hang clean (team lift)
hang-clean.cue: Log your heaviest set of the day.

morning.name: Morning mobility
morning.about: About 10 minutes. Built for a tight lower back and tight hips: open the hips, then switch on the core. Gentle on the first two moves; your spine is stiffest right after waking.

steps.name: Cat-cow
steps.cue: Hands and knees. Slow and small, move one segment at a time. Do not force the rounding.

steps.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
steps.cue: Tuck the tailbone, squeeze the back glute, reach the same-side arm up.

steps.name: 90/90 hip switches
steps.cue: Sit tall, both knees at 90 degrees, rotate side to side. Use hands for support if needed.

steps.name: World's greatest stretch
steps.cue: Deep lunge, elbow toward the instep, then rotate and reach to the ceiling.

steps.name: Glute bridge
steps.cue: 2-second squeeze at the top. Ribs down, do not arch the low back.

steps.name: Bird dog
steps.cue: Opposite arm and leg, 10-second holds. Nothing in the low back moves.

steps.name: Side plank
steps.cue: Straight line ear to ankle. Drop to knees if the hips sag.

steps.name: Dead bug
steps.cue: Low back stays heavy on the floor while the opposite arm and leg reach.

steps.name: Figure-4 glute stretch
steps.cue: On your back, ankle over knee, pull the legs in. Breathe out slowly.

foam-roll.name: Roll and reset
foam-roll.about: About 8 minutes. Slow passes, pause on tight spots, keep breathing.

steps.name: Roll: glutes
steps.cue: Sit on the roller, cross one ankle over the knee, lean into that side.

steps.name: Roll: quads and hip flexors
steps.cue: Face down, hip to just above the knee.

steps.name: Roll: upper back
steps.cue: Hands behind head, roll shoulder blades to mid-back. Stay off the low back.

steps.name: Roll: lats
steps.cue: On your side, arm overhead, armpit to mid-rib.

steps.name: Roll: calves
steps.cue: Cross the other leg on top for pressure.

steps.name: Couch stretch
steps.cue: Back knee against a wall or bench, squeeze the glute, stay tall.

run-speed.name: Speed and intervals
run-speed.why: Monday, on fresh legs: sprint speed first, then repeat-running fitness. Standalone session, track if possible.

parts.title: Warm-up (12 min)
lines: Leg swings, A-skips, high knees, butt kicks: 2 x 20 m each
Smooth and tall. This block is about rhythm, not straining.
Walk back plus 90 s. Stop the set if a hamstring talks to you.
No track: treadmill 6 x 1:35 at 9.4 mph, or 6 x 500 m row
No track: treadmill 4 x 3:15 at 9.2 mph, or 4 x 1000 m row
No track: treadmill 8 x 1:33 at 9.6 mph, or 8 x 500 m row
Deload: 20 min easy run at 8:30-9:00 per mile

parts.title: Cool-down
lines: Calf and hip flexor stretch, 30 s each side

run-easy.name: Easy run (adjusted)
run-easy.why: Your legs took a hard hit yesterday, so the intervals became an easy run.

parts.title: Easy run
lines: You should be able to hold a conversation
Finish with 4 x 15 s relaxed strides

team-lift.name: Lacrosse team lift
team-lift.why: Mandatory. This is where your heavy squats and cleans live, so the rest of the week stays off heavy barbell leg work.

parts.title: Do the team's session
lines: Back check: if squats or cleans light up the low back, drop the load and tell the strength coach.

parts.title: Log your top sets (optional, feeds the charts)

upper-mixed.name: Upper strength and circuit
upper-mixed.why: Wednesday gives your legs a day off between the team lifts. Heavy press and pull, then a fast circuit that keeps the legs out of it.

parts.title: Warm-up (8 min)
lines: Band pull-aparts x 15, scap push-ups x 10, dead hang 30 s

hotel.title: Hotel gym version (dumbbells and a bench)
lines: 5 x 8 single-arm DB row each side
3 x 8 half-kneeling DB press each side
Then AMRAP 12: 10 push-ups, 10 DB push press, 40 m DB farmer carry, 1 min bike or treadmill hard

bodyweight.title: Bodyweight version (no equipment)
lines: 10 towel or table rows (or max pull-ups if a bar exists)
Then 10 min: 30 s burpees, 30 s rest

swim-recovery.name: Swim technique
swim-recovery.why: You float fine and tire fast, which is a technique problem. Short, frequent, easy practice fixes it. Rest as long as you need; never thrash.

byWeek.name: Breathing and balance
lines: 4 x 25 kick with a board, face in, breathe to the side
4 x 25 push off and glide in streamline, then easy kick
4 x 25 side kick (one arm out, face down, roll to breathe)
4 x 25 easy freestyle: exhale steadily underwater, quick sip of air

byWeek.name: Longer reaches
lines: 4 x 25 catch-up drill (one hand waits out front for the other)
Count strokes per length and try to take fewer

byWeek.name: Stringing it together
lines: 4 x 50 breathing every 3 strokes, 30 s rest

byWeek.name: Check-in
lines: Swim easy freestyle without stopping, up to 10 minutes
Log how many minutes you lasted. At 10 minutes, swimming joins your conditioning.

parts.title: No pool today? Do this instead

athlete-day.name: Athlete day
athlete-day.why: Jump, throw, single-leg strength, carry, then a longer mixed circuit. The session to swap for hockey or a friend's workout, and the one to drop on a 4-day week.

parts.title: Warm-up (8 min)
lines: World's greatest stretch x 5 each side, glute bridge x 10, pogo hops x 20

byWeek.name: Machine Triathlon
lines: Hold a pace you could repeat. Score: total time

hotel.title: Hotel gym version
lines: 3 x 8 DB split squat each side
3 x 8 DB single-leg RDL each side
3 x 40 m DB suitcase carry each side
Then AMRAP 15: 2 min treadmill or bike hard, 10 burpees, 20 walking lunges

bodyweight.title: Bodyweight version
lines: 3 x 10 split squat each side, 3 s lowering
3 x 10 single-leg glute bridge each side
Then AMRAP 20: 200 m run (or 40 s high knees), 10 burpees, 20 walking lunges, 30 s side plank each side

athlete-light.name: Athlete day (light)
athlete-light.why: Adjusted to keep you fresh: throws, carries and easy aerobic work, with the jumps and leg strength taken out.

parts.title: Warm-up
lines: World's greatest stretch x 5 each side

parts.title: Zone 2
lines: 20 min easy on SkiErg, rower or bike

recovery-easy.name: Recovery
recovery-easy.why: Something every day, but easy. Pick one option.

parts.title: Pick one
lines: Easy run, 20-30 min at 8:45-9:15 per mile
or 15 min of last Thursday's swim drills

blocks.name: Block 1: Rebuild
blocks.focus: Back-friendly loading at moderate effort, sprint mechanics, aerobic base, swim basics.

swapActivities.name: Friend's workout: full body or CrossFit
